doc: Durable structured browser storage over IndexedDB (LCP-018). The engine declares each database's version, stores and indexes; the pack creates what is declared, drops only what the engine names, and reports anything else as a typed outcome. A transaction is one atomic batch of operations, answered Committed with every result or Aborted with the operation that failed — never partly applied. What the data means, and how it migrates between versions, stays in the engine. localStorage (Core Storage effects) is unchanged.

types.name: StoreSchema
types.doc: keyPath names the field that holds each record's key (a dotted path for a nested field).

types.name: KeyRange
types.doc: A key is a string, a finite number, or a list of keys. Omitted bounds are open-ended.

variants.name: put
variants.doc: Insert or replace the record whose key is at the store's keyPath in value.

variants.name: putIf
variants.doc: Compare-and-put: write value only if the record stored under its key is exactly expected (JSON-equal), or absent when expected is null. Otherwise the whole transaction aborts as a conflict, reporting what is stored — the stale-write guard.

variants.name: query
variants.doc: Records in key order (of the index, when given), at most limit (1 to 1000).

types.name: AbortReason
types.doc: conflict: a putIf found something else. constraint: a unique index was violated. invalidKey: a value has no valid key at the keyPath, or a key is not a valid key. quota: the browser's storage quota was exceeded. unknownStore: the store is not in the open database. other: the browser aborted for another reason.

variants.name: open
variants.doc: Open database at version. Opening at a higher version than the stored one upgrades it: every declared store and index that does not exist is created, and every store in dropStores is deleted — nothing else changes. Opening at the stored version checks the declared schema against the stored one.

variants.name: transact
variants.doc: Run the operations, in order, in one transaction over the stores they name.

types.name: StoreResult
types.doc: Every outcome the engine must handle; the pack retries nothing.

fields.name: upgradedFrom
fields.doc: The version before this open; equal to version when nothing was upgraded, 0 for a new database.

variants.name: VersionConflict
variants.doc: The stored database is newer than the version asked for: this page is out of date.

variants.name: SchemaMismatch
variants.doc: At the stored version, the declared schema and the stored one differ; the connection is not kept. Each problem names a store or index.

variants.name: Blocked
variants.doc: Another page holds an older version open and did not close it; nothing was upgraded. The pack abandons the attempt.

variants.name: Aborted
variants.doc: Nothing in the transaction was applied. operation is the index of the operation that failed, absent when the browser aborted the transaction as a whole at commit (quota, for example); current is what a conflicting putIf found (null when absent).

variants.name: NotOpen
variants.doc: transact or close on a database this page has not opened, or whose connection was closed by a version change.

variants.name: InvalidRequest
variants.doc: A malformed schema, key, range or limit, found before touching the database.

variants.name: Unavailable
variants.doc: This browser or context has no usable IndexedDB (for example some private modes). The exception's name only.

variants.name: Cancelled
variants.doc: The engine cancelled the request. A transaction cancelled while running is aborted, so nothing in it was applied.

variants.name: VersionChanged
variants.doc: Another page upgraded or deleted this database. The pack closed this page's connection so it would not block; the engine reopens at the new version when its code understands it. newVersion is 0 for a deletion.
